## Entry points

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/main/java/com/leonardtrinh/supportsaas/SupportSaasApplication.java` | Spring Boot main — starts HTTP server |

## Data flows

### HTTP request (tenant-aware)
```
Request → JwtAuthFilter (sets TenantContext)
        → SecurityContextHolder
        → Controller → Service
        → Repository (Hibernate filter auto-applies WHERE business_id = :tenantId)
        → Response
        → JwtAuthFilter finally (clears TenantContext)
```

### Document ingestion (async)
```
POST /documents/upload
  → StorageService (MinIO)
  → DocumentService.triggerIngestion()  [async handoff]
    → [Async thread - TenantContextCopyingDecorator propagates tenantId]
    → Parse text (PDF/DOCX/TXT)
    → ChunkService (paragraph-aware, max 1000 tokens)
    → OpenAI text-embedding-3-small
    → PgVector store
    → Full-text tsvector index update
    → Document status → COMPLETED / FAILED
```

### Chat query (RAG + streaming)
```
POST /chat/stream
  → Hybrid search: PgVector (top-10 cosine) + PG full-text
  → Reciprocal Rank Fusion → top-5 chunks
  → Build Claude prompt with chunks as context
  → Spring AI streaming → SSE response
```

---

## What NOT to edit manually

- `target/` — Maven build output, regenerated on every build
- `.env` — secrets, never commit to version control
- `src/main/resources/db/migration/V*.sql` — applied Flyway migrations; add new `V{n+1}__*.sql` files instead

---

## Sensitive areas

| Area | Why sensitive | Rule |
|------|--------------|------|
| `auth/` | JWT issuance, filter chain | Security review before merge |
| `tenant/` | ThreadLocal TenantContext | `clear()` MUST be in `finally`; never skip |
| `document/ingestion/` | Async + tenant propagation | MUST use `@Async("taskExecutor")`, never bare `@Async` |
| `admin/` | Bypasses tenant filter | `disableFilter` allowed ONLY in `Admin*` repositories |
| `billing/` | Stripe integration | Test against Stripe test mode before any change |
| `config/AsyncConfig.java` | Wires `TenantContextCopyingDecorator` | Changes affect ALL async operations |
